title: Conditional κ = .003900857312000 (+0.000001133443% over #8094): tighten the K7 child tariff and Gaussian period
body:
## Result

Conditional κ increases to **0.003900857312000** from **0.003900857267786** on [exact #8094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/c20a08dc0a79a989e3515068560d5da371c0a2a8), the strongest independently reproduced comparable witness and latest relevant peer claim at the comparison refresh. The exact difference is **0.000000000044214** and the relative gain is **+0.000001133443163%**. The exact relative calculation is `100 × (0.003900857312000 − 0.003900857267786) / 0.003900857267786`.

The narrower ordinary child-volume bound supports the charged tariff `2391/1024` and lowers ordinary debit from `1420718/2^20` to `1414404/2^20`. At the same shortcut word and profile, #8085's four-aligned exterior-period bound lowers Gaussian debit from `1039776/2^23` to `1039701/2^23`. Together the bounds clear #8094's exact old crossing. The Gaussian inequality binds. Both changes retain the signed caller and the same five conditional premises. Complete recurring log₂ C is `85945126846`, activation exponent is `268644472`, maximum terminal native height is `134217727`, and fixed setup is below `2^228`.

## Replay

Use Git and CPython 3.12 with assertions enabled and at least 8 GiB free on both volumes. From a clean checkout of this head:

```sh
scratch="$(mktemp -d /tmp/k7-sharper-period.XXXXXX)"
TMPDIR="$scratch" python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-k7-sharper-period
```

The package authenticates the archived #8057 source, exact #8094 inputs and frozen overlays before building. The scoped checks cover signed price and calendar, raw, exterior, nested and product, both true-helper typed widths, dirty forward and adjoint ownership restoration, and the installed nine-recipe census. Negative controls include the wrong Fourier direction, invalid preceding and adjacent profiles, and incorrect return sign. The initial typed harness name collision and its narrow correction are preserved in the staged evidence. [Exact execution receipts and remaining assumptions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a9fa01dd0efbaa6696372a3cd8788e1d75fb35d8/paired-768/r425/REPLAY.md)

The exact #8094 comparison passed locally in seven matching scopes across separate runs. The original registered product attempt hit its 100-second cap. The unchanged product passed under the signed predecessor's 220-second cap in 86.52 seconds. [Independent comparator receipt](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/616be5669b7e21e338bba164e5307b020e9f8005/paired-768/r423/REPLAY.md)

## Predecessor credit

floration supplied #8094's exact word and profile. Ali Romman supplied the #8042 quotient and #8057 signed caller. SYLforge supplied the K7 construction. #8076 supplied the previous tariff and #8082 the reserve removal. #8085/#8087 supplied the exterior-period lemma and replay pattern. Clear1nsight supplied the #8089 hosted control. The package documents the exact references and the combined new charged profile. The separate existing CI prerequisite at `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026` reuses Jerry Chen's #7257 historical guide and snapshot repair. OpenAI Codex materially assisted proof, implementation and verification.

The next open question is whether a smaller directed Gaussian finite factor survives its adjacent-debit control with the same signed ownership, tape and precision charges.

Exact publication commit `826fed2c3382254beea1cba845938fca02fd2dfa` passed metadata, tracked bytes and source history, 760 onboarding tests with 31 skips, both packages selected by the repository planner, and the full candidate registered replay in 418.24 seconds. Hosted results will be recorded separately.
